description.shortText: Digital tests is the application of digital technologies to create, grade, administer, report and manage tests and assessment to evaluate what the learner has learned. Digital tests t systems not only include simply making traditional assessments digital, but also using observational, immersive or artificial-intelligence-enhanced capabilities that collect this insight
